messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: John Miller <john@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Neurolytics SIG prefill + dataflow clarifications

Hi John —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can get the SIG/CAIQ prefilling started:

Summary of ask
- You indicated Neurolytics is evaluating Redwood for inference on protected health data (PHI) in US regions.
- We discussed latency targets and that you need HIPAA support and an SOC 2 timeline.

Immediate next steps
1) Please confirm current SOC 2 status (in-scope date / auditor / if we can share a bridge letter).
2) If you prefer SIG or our CAIQ-prefill, tell us which; we can fill initial answers and flag items needing evidence.
3) We need a network diagram showing egress/inbound flows and any third-party processors (attach if available).
4) Clarify whether you will require our deployment inside your VPC (Private) or if dedicated hosted is acceptable.
5) Data residency: which cloud region(s) must be used and any cross-border constraints?
6) Who on your security team will own evidence uploads? Please share contact and preferred upload method (Drive, SecureShare, or DocuSign).

Attached: please add any existing network diagram or ACL lists. I've attached a SIG-prefill template to speed things up.

Proposed timeline: if you can share prefills by EOD Thu (6/24), Ben (cc'd) and I will collate and return the initial prefill + outstanding evidence list by Mon.

If helpful, we can schedule a short security handoff call. Available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
(s) +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx
From: John Miller <john@neurolytics.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Neurolytics Security <security@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Neurolytics SIG prefill + dataflow clarifications

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers inline:

1) SOC 2: currently in Type II readiness; audit kick-off with Brightline Audit on 2027-08-10. We can share a SOC 2 bridge letter—I'll request it from legal.
2) SIG vs CAIQ: security prefers SIG, but compliance team is familiar with CAIQ. We can accept a SIG prefill and reconcile to CAIQ if you prefer.
3) Network diagram: attached (see network-diagram.png). It includes an external partner (analyticshub.io) and a managed DB provider (CloudVault).
4) Deployment: prefer Private (VPC) due to PHI flows; we need to review VPN tunnel requirements.
5) Residency: US only (primary us-west-2); no EU processing.
6) Evidence owner: cc'd Security alias (security@neurolytics.ai) — please coordinate with Keri Patel (security@neurolytics.ai) for uploads.

We should be able to return a partially completed SIG prefill by Fri (6/25) but can confirm tomorrow after Keri reviews.

-John

Attachments: network-diagram.png
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 07:45:00 -0700

John —

Appreciate the quick answers and the diagram. A few clarifying/evidence asks from the security ops side to help us prefill effectively:

- Can Keri share the scope table for in-scope systems (authentication/IDP, logging, DBs)? A CSV is fine.
- For the DB provider (CloudVault), do you have a vendor contract or an Attestation we can note as a subprocessor?
- Please confirm encryption at rest algorithms for backups (AES-256 is preferred; if different, specify).
- For VPN/VPC: do you have a preferred preshared-key rotation cadence and whether BGP is used on the tunnel?
- Logs: expected retention period for audit logs (required for evidence mapping).

We can start a SIG prefill and mark the above as outstanding evidence. I'm happy to run a 30-minute security handoff with Keri — are you available Thu 6/24 11:00-11:30 PT? If not, propose times.

Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
